messages:
Alex (AE): Quick one — BankCo POC asked for our incident response / breach notification timeline in writing. They want "initial customer notification within 24 hours of confirmation" and a POC for escalation. Can someone paste standard language we can send and map to CAIQ rows?

Maria (InfoSec): Short answer: we have a standard IR playbook. High level timeline we typically describe:
- Detect & acknowledge: 0–4h
- Triage & scope: 4–24h
- Containment & mitigation work in parallel: 4–72h
- Initial customer notification: contract-dependent, but for regulated customers we can commit to initial notification within 24h of confirmed customer-impacting incidents
- Regular updates: every 48–72h until resolution
- Post-incident report: within 30 days

We map these to CAIQ IR sections (IR-01, IR-02, IR-03). See internal doc: https://redwood-internal.company/sigcaiq/answers/ir-2026

Jordan (SE): Here's a short, copyable template you can send to the customer:

```
Subject: Redwood — Incident response & notification for BankCo POC

Hi [Name],

Thanks for the question. For the POC we propose the following incident response commitments:
- Initial customer notification: within 24 hours of confirmed, customer-impacting incidents
- Follow-up updates: every 72 hours (or sooner) until the incident is resolved
- Final root-cause and remediation report: within 30 days

Point of contact for escalation: incidents@redwood.com (Ops); CISO on-call: +1-555-0199

We can also mark these responses in the CAIQ and share the completed export if useful.

Regards,
Jordan
```

Priya (CISO): Two notes: 1) Replace "confirmed" with "confirmed and material to customer data or service" — legal prefers the qualifier. 2) For POCs we SHOULD avoid blanket SLA promises unless signed; offer "POC-specific notice commitment" and say enterprise SLA is in the contract.

Alex (AE): Got it — I'll send with Priya cc'ed to legal. Maria — can you attach which CAIQ rows you filled so I can include them?

Maria (InfoSec): IR-01: playbook link; IR-02: notification timelines (text above); IR-03: forensic logs retention & access. I'll export the CAIQ CSV and post here: https://redwood-internal.company/sigcaiq/exports/bankco-poc-answers.csv

IR Bot: Playbook v2.1 created and linked: https://redwood-internal.company/ir/playbooks/v2.1 (automated)

Alex (AE): Perfect — sending now. Will offer the 24h initial notice for confirmed+material incidents and point them to the CAIQ export. :thumbsup:
